metric_semantics.legacy_error_fields: JSON/CSV fields containing error retain their schema names. For movement_similarity these are distances between different performances, not capture-error estimates.

interpretation: Observed 2D agreement for one recording. No population inference, p-values, or frame-based confidence intervals.

units.position: reference shoulder widths in the image plane

pairing_attestation: User confirmed in Codex chat: exact same physical Addition take

video.timestamp_policy: unrounded decoder seconds; frame_index/fps fallback; integer milliseconds for inference only

upper_body.hand_identity: unique pose-wrist association within 0.35 shoulder widths; opposite wrist at least 0.10 widths farther away
upper_body.hand_quality: detection/presence/IoU thresholds 0.70; no per-landmark confidence supplied; tracking remains provisional
upper_body.hand_crop_policy: full-frame video detection, then missing-hand fallback to image detection on pose-wrist crop, radius 0.60 shoulder widths; unchanged thresholds and identity check

suit.clock_evidence: User confirmed Addition video is exact Rokoko take

non_suit.clock_evidence: User confirmed Addition video is exact Rokoko take

issues: Tracking, boundaries, or calibration remain provisional; inspect the review evidence.
phase_normalized: plausible camera solutions produce materially different position errors.
synchronized: plausible camera solutions produce materially different position errors.

frontal_camera_diagnostic.interpretation: Hypothetical frontal, upright view. Shoulder direction and gravity define the view; torso aspect ratio and wrist/elbow residuals are not fitted. Same rule for both FBXs. This is a camera sensitivity check, not verified capture accuracy.
